modules.title: Payment & Cash Handling and 2 related areas
modules.purpose: To ensure advanced duty managers master payment card security, cash handling procedures, guest data privacy, and service recovery protocols according to Aurelle Hotels & Residences standards.
key_concepts: Personal cash floats and shift close counts
Pre-authorisation limits and original payment refunds
CARE model for service recovery and Duty Manager financial limits
Guest data privacy, purpose limitation, and personal device restrictions
assessment_topics: Cash Handling, Data Privacy, and Service Recovery Execution
modules.completion_criteria: Complete all training tasks, achieve 100% on required compliance checklists, pass the quiz with a score of 80% or higher, and successfully execute practical assessments.

content.text: Apply secure cash handling, float reconciliation, variance reporting, and payment processing standards.
Enforce guest data privacy protocols and restrict data access, storage, and handling on personal devices.
Execute service recovery using the CARE model, appropriate financial authorization limits, and immediate escalation paths.

content.activity: Complete Payment Card Handling training before operating a terminal or cash drawer
Complete Guest Data Privacy training within Week 1

content.description: Conduct a shift-end cash count verification with a second employee, document the float, and verify whether any variance exceeds USD 10 requiring immediate reporting to Finance.
content.expected_outcome: Accurate shift close form submission and proper handling of variances greater than USD 10 on the same day.
content.completion_criteria: Successfully count the cash float with a witness, record the result on the Shift Close Form, and identify if a variance exceeds USD 10 for Finance notification.

content.situation: A guest approaches the front desk demanding a cash refund for a previous payment made via credit card, while complaining about a privacy concern regarding their account data.
expected_actions: Handle the complaint using the CARE model: Calm, Acknowledge, Resolve, Echo back.
Refuse the cash refund because refunds must be processed to the original payment method and cash refunds of card payments are prohibited.
Escalate the sensitive complaint involving data privacy to the Duty Manager immediately, regardless of value.
Log the complaint in the Guest Incident Log within 30 minutes including resolution offered.

content.question: What is the maximum pre-authorisation amount permitted at check-in for incidentals?
content.explanation: Pre-authorisations must be taken through the terminal at check-in and must not exceed the room rate plus 20% for incidentals.

content.question: Cash refunds of card payments are permitted if the guest presents a valid government-issued photo ID.
content.explanation: Refunds must be processed to the original payment method; cash refunds of card payments are prohibited.

content.question: What is the maximum allowed personal cash float issued to a cashier?
content.explanation: Each cashier is issued a personal cash float, which must not exceed USD 500 or local equivalent, and must sign for it at the start of the shift.

content.question: Which cash variance threshold requires same-day reporting to Finance?
content.explanation: Cash variances greater than USD 10 must be reported to Finance on the same day.

content.question: What is the maximum service recovery amount per stay that a Duty Manager may approve without Hotel Manager sign-off?
content.explanation: The Duty Manager may approve service recovery up to USD 300 per stay; above this amount, the Hotel Manager must approve.

content.question: Within what timeframe must every complaint be logged in the Guest Incident Log?
content.explanation: Every complaint must be logged in the Guest Incident Log within 30 minutes, including the resolution offered.

content.topic: Cash Handling, Data Privacy, and Service Recovery Execution

rubric.pass_condition: Zero errors in counting procedure and adherence to variance reporting rules.
rubric.expected_performance: Correctly counts float with a witness, records Shift Close Form, and flags variances over USD 10 for Finance.

rubric.pass_condition: No privacy breaches or improper data storage observed.
rubric.expected_performance: Demonstrates strict adherence to data access rules, avoiding personal devices for identity documents.

rubric.pass_condition: Successful execution of complaint handling steps and escalation criteria.
rubric.expected_performance: Applies CARE model correctly, stays within USD 300 limit, and logs incidents within 30 minutes.

modules.title: Finance Operations and 2 related areas
modules.purpose: To equip Advanced Duty Managers at Aurelle Harbourside Dubai with essential finance procedures, compliance mandates, workplace conduct standards, and employee handbook guidelines.
modules.completion_criteria: Successful completion of all tasks, scenarios, checklist items, and achieving at least 80% on the quiz.

content.text: Apply financial control procedures including purchase orders, three-way matching, city ledger credit limits, and expense claim deadlines.
Comply with Delegation of Authority approvals and company compliance e-learning standards.
Adhere to workplace conduct, uniform, and employee handbook identification and attendance protocols.

content.activity: Sign the Employee Handbook acknowledgement form on Day 1
Collect staff ID badge from Human Resources on Day 1
Sign the Delegation of Authority acknowledgement before exercising any approval limit
Complete the Aurelle Culture e-learning path

content.description: Ensure supplier invoices are verified using the three-way match principle against Purchase Orders and goods received notes.
content.expected_outcome: Invoices correctly cross-referenced before payment processing.
content.completion_criteria: Submit a verification report matching invoices to POs and GRNs.

content.situation: As a Duty Manager with approval authority, you need to place a purchase order for operational equipment valued at USD 1,200 and activate a city ledger credit account worth USD 6,000.
expected_actions: Verify that an approved Purchase Order is obtained before placing the order since it exceeds USD 1,000.
Ensure the Finance Manager approves the city ledger credit account since it exceeds USD 5,000 before account activation.
Verify that the Delegation of Authority acknowledgement has been signed prior to exercising approval limits.

content.question: What is the purchase threshold above which a Purchase Order is required before placing an order with a supplier according to R-FIN-01-001?
content.explanation: Purchases above USD 1,000 require an approved Purchase Order before the order is placed with the supplier [§2.1].

content.question: Supplier invoices must be matched to the Purchase Order and the goods received note before payment.
content.explanation: Supplier invoices must be matched to the Purchase Order and the goods received note before payment [§2.4].

content.question: Who must approve city ledger credit above USD 5,000 per account before the account is activated?
content.explanation: City ledger credit above USD 5,000 per account must be approved by the Finance Manager before the account is activated [§3.1].

content.question: Within how many days of the expense must expense claims be submitted with original receipts?
content.explanation: Expense claims must be submitted with original receipts within 30 days of the expense [§4.2].

content.question: What is the required pass mark for all mandatory e-learning modules in the onboarding plan?
content.explanation: All mandatory e-learning modules in the onboarding plan must be completed with a pass mark of at least 80% within 30 days of joining [§3.1].

content.question: Within how many working days must Finance review the night audit pack and clear all exceptions?
content.explanation: Finance must review the night audit pack and clear all exceptions within one working day [§5.1].

rubric.pass_condition: 100% adherence to financial threshold and delegation rules.
rubric.expected_performance: Correctly applies approval thresholds for purchase orders over USD 1,000 and signs Delegation of Authority acknowledgement.

rubric.criterion: Invoice Matching and Audit Exception Management
rubric.pass_condition: Successfully matches invoices and identifies exception clearance procedures.
rubric.expected_performance: Demonstrates accurate three-way matching and adherence to clearing night audit pack exceptions within one working day.

rubric.pass_condition: All compliance requirements correctly identified and completed.
rubric.expected_performance: Exhibits complete understanding of Day 1 handbook sign-off, biometric attendance, uniform standards, and e-learning deadlines.

modules.title: Front Office Operations
modules.purpose: To equip advanced duty managers and front office associates with rigorous operational procedures regarding guest identification, data privacy, property safety, check-in and check-out rules, and supervisory authority at Aurelle Harbourside Dubai.
key_concepts: Early check-in and late check-out fee rules
PMS certification exemption for experienced staff
Guest data privacy, passport scanning prohibitions on paper, and 7-day retention deletion
Evacuation master key, guest list, and assistance list management
Duty Manager shift authority and back-of-house walk-through logs
assessment_topics: Front Office Operations and Duty Management
modules.completion_criteria: Completion of all D1 and D30 checklist items, successful execution of tasks and scenarios, passing the quiz with 100% accuracy, and positive practical assessment evaluation.

content.text: Master check-in, identity verification, folio settlement, key replacement, and early/late departure fee calculations under SOP-FO-01.
Apply guest data privacy standards for PMS scanning, retention limits, and caller/visitor security restrictions.

Execute safety and leadership responsibilities including evacuation master key management, evacuation roll call leadership, assistance list printing, property walk-throughs, and on-duty operational authority.
Navigate pet policy guidance correctly when guest inquiries arise.

content.activity: Complete PMS Front Desk certification before working a shift alone
Acknowledge Duty Manager role authority as senior manager on duty outside office hours
Perform and log property walk-throughs including back-of-house areas at least twice per shift

content.description: Demonstrate the ability to handle an emergency shift requirement by printing the assistance list at the start of the shift and verifying master key readiness.
content.expected_outcome: Assistance list generated and printed correctly; master key and guest list confirmed in possession.
content.completion_criteria: Successfully generate the assistance list at shift start and verify physical possession of evacuation master key and in-house guest list.

content.situation: An outside caller asks to be connected to Mr. Smith in Room 412 and insists on confirming whether Mr. Smith is currently inside his room before leaving a message.
expected_actions: Refuse to disclose room numbers or guest names directly.
Decline to confirm the guest's presence.
Connect the call directly to the room without verifying presence.

content.question: What is the maximum retention period allowed for scanned copies of guest identity documents in the PMS?
content.explanation: Scanned copies of guest identity documents must be permanently deleted from the PMS no later than 7 days after check-out per GDP-01 Section 4.2.

content.question: Paper copies of a guest's passport or national ID are permitted as backups alongside PMS scanning during check-in.
content.explanation: A guest's passport or national ID may be scanned only into the PMS; paper copies are strictly prohibited per GDP-01 Section 4.1.

content.question: What fee structure applies for a guest requesting an early check-in 4 hours before the standard 15:00 check-in time?
content.explanation: Early check-in up to 2 hours before the standard 15:00 check-in time is free of charge, subject to availability; earlier arrivals are charged 50% of the nightly rate per SOP-FO-01 Section 2.4.

options: Charged at 25% of the nightly rate
Charged at 50% of the nightly rate
content.question: How are late check-outs charged between standard check-out time (12:00) and 18:00?
content.explanation: Standard check-out time is 12:00; late check-out is charged at 50% of the nightly rate until 18:00 and a full night thereafter per SOP-FO-01 Section 3.1.

content.question: Departments other than the Front Office are permitted to open rooms for guests if Front Office is busy.
content.explanation: Replacement room keys may only be issued at Front Office after verifying the guest's identity against the PMS record; other departments must not open rooms for guests per SOP-FO-01 Section 5.2.

content.question: How many times per shift must Duty Managers complete a property walk-through, including back-of-house areas?
content.explanation: Duty Managers must complete a property walk-through, including back-of-house areas, at least twice per shift and log it per ROL-02 Section 2.4.

content.topic: Front Office Operations and Duty Management

rubric.pass_condition: Zero violations of scanning or key issuance policy.
rubric.expected_performance: Correctly verifies identification, scans into PMS, avoids paper copies, and handles replacement key procedures exclusively through Front Office.

rubric.pass_condition: Demonstrates absolute adherence to caller privacy rules.
rubric.expected_performance: Protects guest data by refusing to disclose room numbers or guest names to callers/visitors and correctly transfers calls without confirming presence.

rubric.pass_condition: All safety checklists and walk-through logs completed.
rubric.expected_performance: Manages shift evacuation master key, in-house guest list, and assistance list printing while leading roll call and property walk-throughs.

rubric.pass_condition: Accurate fee computation and folio settlement execution.
rubric.expected_performance: Applies correct check-in and check-out fee calculations, folio settlement, and adheres to Duty Manager operational authority.

At the end of months two, four, and six

content.question: What is the required frequency of formal reviews during an employee's six-month probation period?
content.explanation: New employees must complete a six-month probation period, with formal reviews at the end of months one, three and five.

options: At least two hours before the start of the shift
Within 24 hours of returning to work
Before the end of the calendar day
content.question: When must an employee report an absence due to illness?
content.explanation: Absence due to illness must be reported to the supervisor at least two hours before the start of the shift.

content.question: Employees working night shifts are permitted to leave the property during their paid 30-minute break between 02:00 and 04:00.
content.explanation: Employees working night shifts must take a paid 30-minute break between 02:00 and 04:00 and must not leave the property during it.

options: Up to 10 days; lapsing on 31 December
Up to 5 days; lapsing on 31 March
Up to 15 days; lapsing on 30 June
content.question: What is the maximum number of unused annual leave days that may be carried forward to the next year, and when do excess days lapse?
content.explanation: A maximum of 5 unused annual leave days may be carried forward to the next year; any excess days lapse on 31 March.

options: Escalate to the General Manager within 3 working days
Escalate in writing to Human Resources if unresolved within 5 working days
Escalate to the Department Head after 10 working days
Escalate verbally to Legal after 7 working days
content.question: If a grievance is raised with the direct supervisor and remains unresolved, what is the required timeline and escalation path?
content.explanation: Grievances must be raised first with the direct supervisor and, if unresolved within five working days, escalated in writing to Human Resources.

options: If they miss the assessment deadline once
If they fail a mandatory assessment twice
If they score below 50% on their first attempt
content.question: Under what circumstance must an employee be referred to their manager for a coaching review before a third attempt at a mandatory assessment?
content.explanation: Employees who fail a mandatory assessment twice must be referred to their manager for a coaching review before a third attempt.

content.topic: HR Operations Compliance and Policy Management

content.activity: Acknowledge requirement to report guest data loss or disclosure to Duty Manager and IT within 1 hour
Acknowledge injury reporting rule for guests or employees within 15 minutes

content.completion_criteria: Submit an operational safety audit checklist matching all HSP-01 parameters.

content.situation: At 21:00, a guest reports that a folder containing printed guest reservation data sheets was left unattended and lost in the lobby area. Simultaneously, a hotel employee sustains a minor cut requiring first aid.
expected_actions: Report the suspected data loss to the Duty Manager and IT within 1 hour of discovery.
Report the employee injury to the Manager on Duty (MOD) within 15 minutes.
Classify the data breach as a Severity 1 incident and notify the General Manager within 30 minutes.
Complete the Incident Report in the incident system before the end of the shift.

options: Before the end of the shift
content.question: Within what timeframe must any suspected loss or disclosure of guest data be reported to the Duty Manager and IT?
content.explanation: Any suspected loss or disclosure of guest data must be reported to the Duty Manager and IT within 1 hour of discovery.

content.question: What is the required notification window for reporting any injury to a guest or employee to the Manager on Duty (MOD)?
content.explanation: Any injury to a guest or employee must be reported to the Manager on Duty (MOD) within 15 minutes.

content.question: A data breach is categorized as a Severity 1 incident, requiring the Duty Manager to notify the General Manager within 30 minutes.
content.explanation: The Duty Manager must notify the General Manager within 30 minutes of any Severity 1 incident, meaning death, serious injury, fire, police involvement or a data breach.

options: Before the end of the shift
content.question: When must the Incident Report be completed in the incident system for Severity 1 and 2 incidents?
content.explanation: The Duty Manager must complete the Incident Report in the incident system before the end of the shift for all Severity 1 and 2 incidents.

content.question: What weight threshold requires a load to be lifted by two people or moved with a trolley?
content.explanation: Loads heavier than 20 kg must be lifted by two people or moved with a trolley.

content.question: How often must pool water chlorine and pH levels be tested and logged during opening hours?
content.explanation: Pool water chlorine and pH levels must be tested and logged every 4 hours during opening hours.

Refuse to forward the email to your colleague.

content.question: What is the minimum required character length for passwords according to the Information Security Policy?

content.question: Multi-factor authentication must be enabled for email and for the Property Management System (PMS) before first use.

options: Forward it to your direct line manager for analysis
Use the Report Phishing button and do not forward it to colleagues
Forward it to the entire department as a warning

content.explanation: Suspected phishing emails must be reported using the Report Phishing button and must not be forwarded to colleagues.

options: Log out of the computer entirely
content.question: What action is required when leaving your workstation unattended?
content.explanation: Workstations must be locked whenever they are left unattended.

Granted automatically upon employment contract signing
content.question: Where are system access requests submitted and when are they granted?
content.explanation: System access is requested by the line manager through the IT portal and is granted only after the Information Security Basics module has been completed.

content.question: Within what timeframe must all found items be logged in the Lost & Found register?
content.explanation: All found items must be logged in the Lost & Found register within 1 hour of being found.

content.question: What is the mandatory retention period for non-valuable items before disposal or donation?
content.explanation: Non-valuable items must be kept for 90 days and valuables for 180 days before disposal or donation.

content.question: Who is authorized to waive late check-out fees?
content.explanation: Late check-out fees may be waived only by the Duty Manager, and the reason for the waiver must be recorded in the PMS.

Start at 03:00 and be completed before 06:00
content.question: What are the exact start and completion time boundaries for the night audit?
content.explanation: The night audit must start at 02:00 and be completed before 05:00.

options: List them on the Rate Exception Report for Revenue review
Charge the guest the full published rate
Ignore if guest checks out successfully
content.question: What action must be taken for rate overrides above 15% of the published rate without an approval code?
content.explanation: Rate overrides above 15% of the published rate without an approval code must be listed on the Rate Exception Report for Revenue review.

content.question: By what time must the night audit pack be saved to the Finance shared folder?
content.explanation: The night audit pack, containing the reports listed in Annex 1, must be saved to the Finance shared folder before 06:00.
